task.title: Advanced Transformation Functions & Expression Builder
task.description:
Build a comprehensive transformation function library and visual expression builder to enable complex data transformations without coding. Features include:

1. **Function Library Panel** (left sidebar in mapping view):
   - Categorized function groups: String (concat, substring, trim, replace, regex), Date (format, parse, add/subtract, timezone), Math (round, floor, ceil, sum, average), Conditional (if-then-else, switch-case, coalesce), Array (map, filter, join, split), and Lookup (reference tables, external APIs)
   - Search/filter functions with live preview
   - Drag-and-drop function chips to field mappings
   - Function documentation tooltips with examples

2. **Visual Expression Builder** (inline in field mapping rows):
   - Click field value to open expression editor modal
   - Formula bar showing current expression syntax
   - Visual function composer with nested function blocks
   - Parameter inputs with type validation and autocomplete
   - Live preview pane showing transformation result on sample data
   - Syntax highlighting and error indicators
   - Support for combining multiple functions (e.g., CONCAT(TRIM(sourceField), ' - ', FORMAT_DATE(dateField, 'YYYY-MM-DD')))

3. **Function Execution Engine**:
   - Runtime evaluator for complex expressions
   - Type coercion and validation
   - Error handling with specific failure messages per function
   - Performance optimization for bulk transformations
   - Support for custom JavaScript functions with sandboxing

4. **Expression Templates**:
   - Saved expression library per workspace
   - Common patterns (full name from first/last, address concatenation, date standardization)
   - Template variables for reusable logic
   - Import/export expression library

5. **Testing Integration**:
   - Auto-update Results tab when expressions change
   - Show transformation steps for each record in debug mode
   - Highlight which function caused errors in validation panel
task.rationale: Users can currently map fields but cannot transform data during the mapping process. This is the core value proposition of a mapping tool — enabling data shape changes, format conversions, and business logic application. Without transformation functions, users are limited to 1:1 field copying, which is insufficient for real-world integration scenarios. This feature unlocks the full potential of the mapping engine and differentiates the product from simple field mappers. It directly builds on the real-time testing capability by giving users powerful transformations to test.

issues: XSS vulnerability: REPLACE function uses search parameter directly in RegExp constructor without escaping, allowing ReDoS attacks. Must sanitize/escape special regex characters before new RegExp(search, 'g')
Division by zero: DIVIDE function doesn't check if denominator is zero, will return Infinity/NaN. Add explicit check: if (b === 0) return null or throw error
Missing accessibility: function-chip, category-header lack ARIA roles (role='button'), aria-expanded, aria-labelledby. Modal missing aria-modal='true' and focus trap for keyboard navigation
data.feedback: Critical security fixes required: 1) In REPLACE function, escape regex special chars: search.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&') before RegExp. 2) Add zero-check in DIVIDE: if (Math.abs(b) < Number.EPSILON) return null. 3) Add ARIA attributes: <div class='function-chip' role='button' tabindex='0' aria-label='...'>, <button class='category-header' aria-expanded='false'>, <div class='modal-overlay' role='dialog' aria-modal='true' aria-labelledby='modalTitle'>. 4) Implement keyboard handlers for Enter/Space on draggable chips. 5) Add focus trap in modal (focus first/last focusable element). 6) Validate function inputs: check for null/undefined before operations. 7) Fix CSS typo line 498: '::before' not '::bef'. 8) Add prototype pollution check in LOOKUP: if (!obj.hasOwnProperty(key)) return null. Address security issues immediately before deployment.

issues: CRITICAL SECURITY: REPLACE function vulnerable to ReDoS attacks - user-controlled regex patterns passed to new RegExp() without validation or timeout protection can cause denial of service
CRITICAL SECURITY: LOOKUP function prototype pollution vulnerability - doesn't block '__proto__', 'constructor', 'prototype' keys allowing potential object injection attacks
CRITICAL SECURITY: No Content Security Policy meta tags and no visible input sanitization strategy for user-generated expressions in formula-bar, creating XSS attack surface
data.feedback: SECURITY FIXES REQUIRED: (1) For REPLACE function: implement regex pattern validation, use try-catch around new RegExp(), add execution timeout, and consider allowlisting safe patterns instead of escaping. (2) For LOOKUP: add explicit checks: `if(['__proto__','constructor','prototype'].includes(key)) return null;` before hasOwnProperty check. (3) Add CSP meta tag: `<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'">`. (4) Sanitize all user inputs before display using DOMPurify or similar. (5) Add input validation for all function parameters with type checking and range limits. (6) Complete the truncated _evaluateExpression implementation. ACCESSIBILITY: Add lang attribute to html tag, ARIA labels to interactive elements, and implement keyboard trap management for function panel. CSS: Close .function-block-header style block. Add viewport meta with user-scalable=no for production.

issues: CSP policy blocks 'unsafe-inline' styles but extensive inline styles are used throughout - either remove 'unsafe-inline' or move styles to external stylesheet
Missing closing for .modal-footer rule (line ends with 'ga' - appears truncated)
No focus trap implementation for modals - keyboard users can tab out of modal to background content

Critical Security: Missing input sanitization and XSS protection when rendering user-provided function parameters - evaluateExpression function could enable arbitrary code execution if not properly sandboxed

Critical Accessibility: Modal and function library panel lack proper ARIA attributes (role='dialog', aria-modal='true', aria-labelledby, aria-hidden state management) and no focus trap implementation for keyboard users
Critical HTML/CSS: Incomplete CSS block (ends mid-declaration 'display: inline') causing potential page rendering failure - no closing style tag present
data.feedback: 1. IMMEDIATE FIX - Complete the CSS block by adding closing brace and </style> tag. 2. SECURITY - Implement strict input validation/sanitization for all user inputs (param-input fields, formula-input) and ensure evaluateExpression uses a safe sandboxed evaluation method, never eval(). Add Content-Security-Policy meta tag. 3. ACCESSIBILITY - Add proper ARIA attributes: modal needs role='dialog' aria-modal='true' aria-labelledby, function panel needs aria-hidden toggling, implement focus trap for both, add aria-labels to icon-only buttons, add aria-live regions for draggable chips feedback. 4. Add keyboard handlers (Escape key) to close modal/panel. 5. Connect form labels properly with 'for' attributes and implement validation error messaging structure. 6. Fix layout shift by replacing body margin manipulation with transform-based panel sliding.

missing: ExpressionBuilderModal - Full-screen modal with formula bar, visual function composer, parameter inputs with autocomplete, and live preview pane
FunctionBlockComponent - Visual representation of functions in expression composer with parameter slots and nested function capability
ExpressionTemplateLibrary - Modal view for saved expression templates with CRUD operations and import/export
DebugModePanel - Expandable section showing step-by-step transformation execution with function call hierarchy
ValidationErrorDetail - Enhanced error display with specific function failure information and suggested fixes
Function library with all transformation functions (string, math, date, array, conditional, custom)
Live preview capabilities showing transformation results on sample data
Nested function support in visual composer
data.note: Code only implements the FunctionLibraryPanel UI shell and basic styling. Missing: ExpressionBuilderModal (core feature), runtime execution engine, all transformation functions, drag-and-drop composition, live preview, template management, debug panel, validation details, and most critical functionality. Only ~15% of spec requirements are present.

blocking_issues: Incomplete JavaScript code - the 'now' function description and subsequent code are cut off, breaking functionality
Missing critical form controls - no visible way for users to create or edit mappings without the modal
No visible UI rendered - the HTML body is completely empty, no main interface elements present
Missing aria-labels on icon buttons, making them inaccessible to screen readers
Modal traps focus but no visible focus management implementation for keyboard navigation
No error boundaries or fallback UI if JavaScript fails to load
No error handling for malformed JSON in drag-and-drop data transfer - will crash on parse failure
Memory leak: Event listeners in setupEventListeners() not cleaned up, duplicate listeners added on re-initialization
No <label> elements associated with form inputs - breaks screen reader accessibility and click targets
Modal does not trap focus - keyboard users can tab outside modal to background content
No skip navigation link - keyboard users must tab through entire function panel
CSS uses fixed positioning without accounting for content reflow on small screens - function panel forces horizontal scroll on mobile
Body overflow hidden on modal/panel open prevents scrolling but doesn't preserve scroll position
Inputs lack proper ARIA labels and error state announcements for screen readers
No visible focus indicators meet WCAG 2.1 contrast requirements (current focus styles too subtle)
Draggable function chips have no keyboard alternative - completely inaccessible to non-mouse users
